name: Kindex memory
description: A knowledge graph on the agent's computer that outlasts the team: decisions, constraints and discoveries agents search and add to across sessions.
briefing: You also have Kindex (the kindex tools): a knowledge graph on this computer that outlasts this team. Search it before starting something it may cover, and add durable decisions and discoveries to it. Sculptured's record_lesson tells this team; Kindex keeps knowledge for later work in this project.
